summary: The revision adequately resolves the arbitrary-type test and deferred-model terminology findings. No blocker or major issue remains; one stale paragraph still contradicts the corrected description of phase-context construction.

findings.issue: Although §4 now correctly describes constructor-based phase contexts, §6 still says that path uses model_copy/model_construct and bypasses validation. engine.py:998 constructs the phase context through AgentContext(...).
findings.why_it_matters: The contradictory test guidance could direct propagation tests toward helper operations instead of the actual phase reconstruction path.
findings.suggested_fix: Align §6 with §4 and explicitly require process_turn through both phases, asserting the trusted fields observed by agents.
